reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: The static ifile sentinel owns no heap names initially and anchor's next/prev links point back to itself; allocated nodes form a circular list around it.
owner_creation.invariant: The sentinel is permanent image storage, not a node allocation.
limitations: anchor owns the sentinel object while list nodes are separate allocations.

aliases_escapes.analysis: Traversal of anchor lends raw node addresses; the static sentinel cannot extend the lifetime of a node deleted elsewhere.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Sentinel traversal cannot validate a retained node handle.
limitations: Circular links can point into nodes whose handles outlive list mutations.

callback_targets.analysis: Operations around anchor call mark_check_ifile/unmark and ch disposal directly during node-list mutation.
callback_targets.invariant: Related mark callbacks must see a coherent list.
limitations: Direct list helpers do not revoke all outside IFILE aliases.

invalidation.analysis: unlink updates neighboring links and later frees the node; the anchor sentinel remains live, but no generation prevents a stale external node address from being reused.
invalidation.invariant: Permanent sentinel lifetime does not protect deleted nodes.

mutation_commit.analysis: link_ifile changes anchor-neighbor links before indexes/counts, without a guard preventing observation of intermediate state.
mutation_commit.invariant: List and index publication is not an atomic commit.

release_pair.analysis: The anchor sentinel must never be passed to free; only separately allocated nodes and their strings are released by del_ifile.
release_pair.invariant: Heap-node cleanup excludes the static anchor.
limitations: The static anchor must never be freed with allocated ifile nodes.

error_cleanup.analysis: Allocation before linking leaves anchor unchanged; fatal cleanup during later node/name mutation still relies on coherent list links.
error_cleanup.invariant: Error traversal still relies on raw list coherence.

signals_handoff.analysis: No event-loop owner or signal mask protects anchor-linked mutation; this is the concrete list-state concern under M0-MEM-001.
signals_handoff.invariant: M0-MEM-001 remains open for sentinel-linked ownership.
limitations: This reviews the anchor object and its adjacent link protocol; independent external node users and asynchronous cleanup remain unapproved.
